# Architecture

6 modules declaring 25 events (25 internal, 0 external). Generated from the ZDL files: edit the models, not this page.

## Overview

The system has too many modules or events for one diagram, so this overview shows modules only. Each module page has the diagram of that module.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  classDef module fill:#e8f0fe,stroke:#4a6fa5,stroke-width:2px,color:#111

  CatalogInventory{{"Catalog Inventory"}}
  CatalogProducts{{"Product Catalog"}}
  FulfillmentShipping{{"Fulfillment Shipping"}}
  NotificationsConsumer{{"Notifications Consumer"}}
  OrdersCheckout{{"Orders Checkout"}}
  PaymentsProcessing{{"Payments Processing"}}

  class CatalogInventory,CatalogProducts,FulfillmentShipping,NotificationsConsumer,OrdersCheckout,PaymentsProcessing module

  CatalogInventory -.->|"1 event"| OrdersCheckout
  FulfillmentShipping -.->|"2 events"| PaymentsProcessing
  OrdersCheckout -.->|"1 event"| FulfillmentShipping
  OrdersCheckout -.->|"2 events"| NotificationsConsumer
  OrdersCheckout -.->|"1 event"| PaymentsProcessing
  PaymentsProcessing -.->|"3 events"| CatalogInventory
  PaymentsProcessing -.->|"1 event"| NotificationsConsumer
  PaymentsProcessing -.->|"1 event"| OrdersCheckout
  OrdersCheckout ==>|"2 calls"| CatalogInventory
```

Hexagon = module. Rectangle inside a box = internal event owned by that module. Pipe outside boxes = external event (has a topic). Solid = published by. Dashed = consumed by. Thick = direct call.

### Events with no consumers

No service method in these files listens to them. An external event may be an integration point for other systems.

- StockAdjusted (Catalog Inventory, internal)
- StockReceived (Catalog Inventory, internal)
- StockReservationConfirmed (Catalog Inventory, internal)
- ProductPublished (Product Catalog, internal)
- ProductRetired (Product Catalog, internal)
- FulfillmentReadyToShip (Fulfillment Shipping, internal)
- NotificationDeliveryFailed (Notifications Consumer, internal)
- OrderCancelledNotificationSent (Notifications Consumer, internal)
- OrderConfirmationSent (Notifications Consumer, internal)
- StockUnavailableNotificationSent (Notifications Consumer, internal)
- PaymentRetried (Payments Processing, internal)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
